summary.text: Father of Nastes and Amphimachus (`nastes-nomionid`, `amphimachus-nomionid`), the glorious captains twain of the Carians who held Miletus, Phthires, the Maeander, and Mycale's steep crests.

story.text: Homer names Nomion only as the father of the Carian captains Nastes and Amphimachus when the Catalogue musters the allies from Miletus and the Maeander country — Nastes came to the war all decked with gold like a girl, fool that he was, but his gold availed not to ward off woeful destruction beneath Achilles' hands.
